decisions.reason: Although its web prominence eased after launch, it remains in the assortment and fits the firm's core upholstery business well enough to justify retention in a growing market.
This decorative fabric never gained strong prominence and appears less differentiated than the firm's other sheer and textured offerings, so its resources are better reused elsewhere.
Its continued dedicated presentation and its flame-retardant functional profile make it a strong fit for the firm's contract and hospitality customers.
As a wool-blend decorative item with limited visibility, it looks more replaceable and less aligned with the firm's push to simplify materials and reduce hard-to-recycle blends.
This fabric supports the firm's design-led premium positioning and its wool-based character fits the move toward more renewable materials despite its niche role.
As a newly launched product with its own page and use across both upholstery and curtains, it shows strong strategic relevance and should be given more time to scale.
